title: SEM: Sparse Embedding Modulation for Post-Hoc Debiasing of Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using cross-modal retrieval on the FairFace, UTKFace, and CelebA datasets with stereotype and hair color queries (measuring KL Divergence and MaxSkew), as well as zero-shot classification on CelebA measuring worst-group accuracy and performance gaps.

Evaluated using cross-modal retrieval on the FairFace and UTKFace datasets with stereotype queries, measuring KL Divergence and MaxSkew to assess the distribution of retrieved images across different racial/ethnic groups.
Evaluated using zero-shot classification on the Waterbirds dataset, measuring worst-group accuracy and performance gaps to test model reliance on background contexts rather than core object features.
